notes.title: April 11th, 2024 - Even more hilarious AI, more content, and bug fixes
notes.content:
We've got a great AI model upgrade in this release.  Expect even funnier AI answers in your games.  Additionally, we've added a bunch of new prompts for players to provide some more gameplay variety.

Some other fixes and quality of life improvements include:

- Bug fixes for muting sound effects and vocals.
- A single prompt will can longer be used multiple times per round.
- Points are now worth 100 on the first round, 150 on the second, and 200 on the third.

Enjoy and as always, feel free to reach out to hello@krani.al with your feedback.

notes.title: November 2023 Update
notes.content:
Welcome to our first update since launch!  Today, we're introducing some new features, improvements, and a couple tweaks.

First off, [b]you should notice vast improvements in the quality of the AI responses![/b]  Training a humorous large language model has been an exciting adventure, and we'll keep iterating on this as AI technology develops!

Second, you'll notice [b]a new option in the game controller which allows up to 50 people to join a game as audience members[/b].  Audience members can add a few points to their favorite responses during each voting round to give a players an edge over their competition.  This is a great way to involve more people in a single game, whether you're having a party or on a streaming platform.  This feature is marked as a beta for now while we feel out the server load that comes with it!

Third, [b]we've upgraded the text-to-speech readouts that occur during the voting round[/b] to sound more lifelike.

Finally, we've made some tweaks to sound effect mixing as well to make the game a smoother experience. A longer soundtrack is also in the works.

Enjoy!
